correctness.rationale: For crisp Godel S4 finite birelational frames, eight explicit models have 1–3 worlds, both relations reflexive/transitive, intuitionistic preorder locally linear, modal relation forward/backward/downward confluent, and atomic upset valuations. Independently implemented set-based semantics for intuitionistic negation, birelational box and diamond were run on the exact 35 stated operator words. For each word the eight truth sets form its fingerprint; all 35 fingerprints are distinct, so all 595 unordered pairs have at least one genuine separating finite model. The proof needs only sound valid finite countermodels and does not infer completeness of any finite model census. Primary 2021 Balbiani–Dieguez–Fernandez-Duque Def II.4 and Lemma II.6 validate the confluence/semantic conventions. Result: at least 35 equivalence classes, not exactly 35. Original Pacheco upper reduction to 105 is only attributed from source package and abstract due primary full-text access restriction.

The assigned package reports Theorem18 reduction to <=105; because complete primary text was unavailable we do NOT assert the entire paper lacks stronger results. The older 2021 complete GS4 frame semantics and finite model property do not automatically give 35 distinct words. Resultary modality queries located other logics and Gödel-frame topics, not exact 35. Best-of-knowledge PASS with significant risk of uninspected Pacheco full text, not a blanket no-coverage claim.
